# Chaiwala

> A three-era chai and coffee counter in India. Customers order online without an account, pay with UPI, cards or wallets through Razorpay, and collect their order at the counter by showing a single-use QR token.

## Pages

- [Home](https://im-chandanmahapatra.github.io/CHAI-WALA/v2/): what Chaiwala is, the three eras, how ordering works, signature dishes
- [Order](https://im-chandanmahapatra.github.io/CHAI-WALA/v2/order/): the ordering page with the live menu, order summary and token pass
- [Menu](https://im-chandanmahapatra.github.io/CHAI-WALA/v2/menu/): every item with prices in rupees, grouped by era
- [How it works](https://im-chandanmahapatra.github.io/CHAI-WALA/v2/how-it-works/): the ordering, payment and token process, with FAQs

## Menu

### 1900s: The Adda
- Masala Chai: ₹45. Seven-spice house masala, steeped deep over a slow flame.
- Adrak Chai: ₹40. Hand-crushed ginger and Assam CTC. The street-side morning bite.
- Elaichi Chai: ₹40. Green cardamom cracked fresh into rich slow-boiled milk tea.
- Cutting Chai: ₹25. The quick half-glass recharge. Strong, sweet, tapri style.
- Bun Maska: ₹45. Soft bakery bun with a generous slab of salted butter. Dip it.
- Biscuit Plate: ₹30. Osmania butter biscuits and cumin crackers for dunking.

### 2000s: The Coffee House
- Classic Cold Coffee: ₹90. Thick, frothy, blended. The coffee-house shake you split two ways.
- Hot Filter Coffee: ₹60. South Indian decoction pulled high with frothed milk.
- Hot Chocolate: ₹95. Dark cocoa churned with steamed milk. Rainy-day essential.
- Veg Grilled Sandwich: ₹90. Bombay-style toastie with green chutney and molten cheese.
- Truffle Pastry: ₹85. Dark sponge layered with silky truffle ganache.
- Sea Salt Brownie: ₹80. 70% dark chocolate with a crackle top and flaky salt.

### 2020s: The Café
- Uji Matcha Oat Latte: ₹140. Ceremonial grade matcha whisked over silky oat milk.
- Citrus Tonic Cold Brew: ₹100. 16-hour cold brew over tonic, crystal ice and orange peel.
- Brown Sugar Pearl Boba: ₹150. Roasted milk tea, warm brown sugar marbling, chewy pearls.
- Fresh Lemon Tea: ₹50. Clear black tea, hand-squeezed lemon and sweet mint.
- Herbal Ginger Tea: ₹50. Dairy-free ginger root infusion with honey and lemon.
- Butter Croissant: ₹90. Hand-laminated, honeycomb layers, cultured butter.
- Jalapeño Melt Toastie: ₹120. Sourdough, aged cheddar and pickled jalapeño heat.

## Notes

- Staff pages (/counter/, /board/) are not for customers and are excluded from indexing.
